title: OpenAI Codex app expands with plugins, automations and computer use
summary: OpenAI's Codex desktop app gains a plugin store (browser use, Sentry, macOS app builder, etc.), scheduled automations, multi-project management, computer-use and browser-use plugins, and direct PR/commit pushing. Free tier available; installs on Windows and macOS.

research.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal; the desktop app builds on this with a plugin store and scheduled automations.
